newsitem.title: USA: EA Industries ends talks with Aydin.
newsitem.headline: EA Industries ends talks with Aydin.

text.p: EA Industries Inc said Wednesday it has ended merger talks with Aydin Corp after its final offer was rejected by Aydin.
The company said it will continue to hold Aydin shares as an investment.
EA Industries also said Wednesday that its subsidiary, Tanon Manufacturing Inc, has signed a letter of intent to acquire Tri-Star Technologies Co Inc.
It said the deal would provide an immediately positive effect on its earnings. Terms were not disclosed. The company did not say when it expected the transaction to close.
In the second quarter ended June 29, EA Industries reported a net loss of $1.6 million, or $0.09 per share, on sales of $22.4 million.
Tri-Star is a contract manufacturer that fabricates printed circuit boards, designs and builds electronic prototypes, and assembles and tests a variety of products.
